senses.en: (genetics) genetic variation in a DNA sequence that occurs when a single nucleotide in a genome is altered; SNPs are usually considered to be point mutations that have been evolutionarily successful enough to recur in a significant proportion of the population of a species
senses.zh: （遗传学）基因组中某个单核苷酸发生改变而形成的DNA序列变异；原文将SNP描述为在物种种群中达到相当比例的点突变。
